description: Track product champions for job changes and qualify their new companies against ICP. Takes a CSV of known champions (with LinkedIn URLs), creates a baseline snapshot via Apify enrichment, then detects when champions move to new companies. Scores new companies on a 0-4 ICP fit scale. Outputs a downloadable CSV of movers with qualification verdicts.
